method: Eight parallel auditors checked the exact published strings for 42 tokens against primary sources, then independent agents tried to refute every finding, then the survivors were confirmed by hand. Six findings were killed at the refute stage and are not listed here. Every correction below carries the URL that establishes it.

corrections.find: Most active perp DEX on Solana. v3 cross-margin launching June 2026. 35% Solana perp market share.
corrections.replace: Exploited for $286M on 1 April 2026 through a compromised admin key and offline since. TVL fell from about $550M to under $250M. Held roughly 35% of Solana perp DEX volume before the attack.
corrections.why: The page described a protocol that has been down for four months as the most active perp DEX on Solana.

cite.claim: Drift Protocol exploited for $286M on 1 April 2026, TVL fell from about $550M to under $250M, the largest DeFi hack of 2026 to date

corrections.replace: Relaunch after the 1 April 2026 exploit, no confirmed date
corrections.why: A June 2026 launch date advertised as forthcoming in August 2026, for a protocol that was offline.

corrections.find: VC open Sep 2026 (150M tokens), Solana network risk, competition from Zeta Markets
corrections.replace: Exploited for $286M on 1 April 2026 via a compromised admin key, deposits and withdrawals suspended. VC vesting Sep 2026 (150M tokens), Solana network risk, competition from Zeta Markets
corrections.why: The principal risk field omitted the realised $286M exploit entirely.
